items.text: This is not the Firefly sim you are looking for, at worst, and at best, not yet. While still in early access, the game is pretty far from being accessible and fun. The genius lies in the in-world manuals that teach you everything you need to know about space travel. The horror lies in the absolute lack of usable and quality materials since the wear and tear update. It has been impossible for me to get everything I need to turn a derelict into a running ship. It has been hard to find reactors and power. I don't even know how the crew system works because I can't afford to pay them. Ostranauts is one to forget about for a year or two, and then maybe watch someone play it on youtube before you buy. I've got high hopes for this game, but it does need a lot of work.
items.text_zh: 这不是你在找的那个《萤火虫》模拟器，往最坏里说，至少目前还不是。虽然仍处于抢先体验阶段，这款游戏离易上手和有趣还差得很远。其天才之处在于游戏世界内的手册，它们教会你关于太空旅行所需知道的一切。其恐怖之处在于自磨损与损耗更新以来，绝对缺乏可用且高质量的材料。我一直无法凑齐把一艘废弃飞船变成可运行飞船所需的一切。很难找到反应堆和电力。我甚至不知道船员系统是怎么运作的，因为我付不起他们的工资。Ostranauts是那种应该先忘掉一两年，然后也许在买之前先看看别人在YouTube上玩它的游戏。我对这款游戏抱有很高的期望，但它确实需要大量工作。

observations.description: 磨损更新后，缺乏可用且高质量的材料，难以将废弃飞船修复为可运行状态。
observations.evidence: The horror lies in the absolute lack of usable and quality materials since the wear and tear update. It has been impossible for me to get everything I need to turn a derelict into a running ship.
observations.evidence_zh: 恐怖之处在于，自从磨损与老化更新以来，可用的优质材料绝对匮乏。我一直无法凑齐把一艘废弃飞船变成能运转的飞船所需的一切。
